statusVocabulary.VERIFIED: The permission is supported by evidence that identifies the relevant work or service and the reviewed scope.
statusVocabulary.RESTRICTED: The evidence grants only a limited use or explicitly prohibits part of the intended use.
statusVocabulary.UNKNOWN: No evidence was found that safely proves the permission for the exact work. UNKNOWN never means allowed.
statusVocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: The field does not apply to the current delivery model.

commercialUse.note: Generated images are allowed for personal online activities. The official terms prohibit use in products made by companies or commercial organizations and prohibit selling or profiting from generated images.

embedOrPublicPerformance.note: The official terms prohibit embedding/framing/mirroring/proxying without prior written permission. Live headers also send X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN and CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.

attributionRequired.note: A link is appreciated for ordinary personal online use; attribution and a link are required for permitted personal, non-commercial printed/video/game uses described by the terms.

modificationAllowed.note: The terms allow editing generated images. They do not allow copying or modifying the generator, scripts, data or other site resources without written permission.

assetRedistributionAllowed.note: Copying, republishing, redistributing, hotlinking or systematically downloading site resources is prohibited without written permission.

directLinkAllowed.note: The official terms explicitly allow linking to individual generator pages.
